 Description 
Our client is a leading provider of advanced structural engineering software used by civil and structural engineers across Europe. Their solutions support the design, analysis, and verification of buildings and structural systems in accordance with Eurocode standards. They are currently looking for an experienced Structural Applications Engineer professional with a Structural Engineering background to support customers using advanced engineering analysis software. 
At this role you will work at the intersection of engineering, software, and customer success - supporting users, delivering training, and working closely with product development teams to improve solutions based on customer needs.
